chunks: For them are coverings of fire from above them and coverings of fire from below them; this is with which God warns His servants. O My servants, fear Me.
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'coverings of fire from above and below' signify in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'coverings' (ẓulal) of fire above and below signify a comprehensive enclosure of punishment, reflecting the divine justice that befalls those who rejected the Imams and the truth. This verse serves as a stern warning to the servants, urging them to cultivate God-consciousness (taqwa) to avoid the fate of the disbelievers who were enveloped by their own deeds.
